purpose: Fix only the remaining Phase403 writer-output contract violation: the fresh writer emitted a title-like label before the prose and editorial suggestions after the prose even though the literary/reader-drive architecture passed all other required hidden gates.

trailing_editorial_lines: 让父女冲突再具体一些
把签字线索收得更有回响

evidence: The Phase403 writer entry explicitly mentioned title/editorial/self-evaluation categories in negative instructions.
The writer nevertheless emitted a title-like label and editorial suggestions matching those prohibited modes.
residual_failure_families.causal_hypothesis: Enumerating forbidden assistant/editor modes can keep those response modes semantically active and available at the beginning/end of a long completion.

evidence: The literary task asks for fiction prose but does not structurally define line 1 as prose sentence 1 or define a terminal response boundary after the final prose sentence.
The assistant therefore retains ordinary chat freedom to wrap the content with a helpful label or follow-up suggestions.
residual_failure_families.causal_hypothesis: A content-generation instruction is weaker than an explicit response-surface transaction: the model needs a positive rule for what the entire response surface consists of, not only a list of forbidden add-ons.

evidence: The three trailing lines are not story continuation; they are editorial optimization notes.
The same family of trailing advice also appeared in earlier isolated writer attempts.
residual_failure_families.causal_hypothesis: After the model decides the prose passage is complete, the chat assistant role can reassert itself and append helpful editorial follow-up unless response termination is part of the frozen output contract.

rejected_repairs: delete title or suggestions after generation
best-of-N and select the cleanest response

minimal_architecture_direction.mechanism: Keep the entire Phase403 writer-visible literary payload unchanged while replacing the chat/meta wrapper with a positive closed response-surface transaction.
response_surface_contract: The response consists of exactly one fiction prose body.
Line 1 is the first sentence of the fiction passage, not a label or category name.
After the final fiction sentence, the response terminates immediately.
The final non-whitespace character belongs to the fiction passage and is terminal prose punctuation.

preparation_acceptance_tests: Phase403 literary payload/view is reused without modification.
Response-boundary redesign does not mention the Phase403 offending title or editorial suggestions inside writer-visible instructions.
Writer-visible wrapper does not enumerate title/self-evaluation/editorial-note categories as a negative checklist.
Line 1 is positively defined as the first fiction sentence.
Response termination is positively defined immediately after the final fiction sentence.
No structured envelope, JSON, markdown fence or marker may remain in returned output.
Validation contract allows one A1, one candidate, no retry, no best-of-N, no A2, no second window.
No prose pilot runs before architecture-ready PASS and readiness/guard PASS.
forbidden: add AI-smell, mechanical-dialogue, paragraph or question rules
enter human review before all required gates clear
advance Phase320 accepted checkpoint from design or hidden gates alone
next_action: Build the Phase404 output-contract causal diagnosis, freeze PROSE_BODY_ONLY_RESPONSE_TRANSACTION_V1 and a single-A1 validation contract, then audit whether one isolated A1 is justified. Do not generate prose yet.
